searchText: Any help team I need help Does anyone know if ERC-4337 has been implemented yet? It has been implemented yes, companies are running the infra (e.g. Biconomy, Pimlico, Alchemy, Cometh, etc.), wallets are building on top of it too (e.g. Safe, Zerodev, Coinbase wallet). It is somewhat still a work in progress in term of standard Excellent, does the Bundler, UserOperation, etc. need to be implemented by DAPP itself? Hi <@235037144568037376>, I couldn't find the code in the main branch of go-ethereum, according to keywords like bundler. Nope, this is abstracted away by SDKs such as biconomy or permissionless JS Bundler infra is done by external actors Note that this is probably the wrong channel to discuss this I see. Thank you very much!
